sections.heading: 1. Who We Are
paragraphs: SystemForge (forjadesistemas.com.br) is a custom software development studio. Pedro Corgnati, Rua Example, 123 — São José dos Campos, SP, Brazil 12220-000, is responsible for the personal data processed through this website. Contact: contato@forjadesistemas.com.br

sections.heading: 2. Data We Collect
paragraphs: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide when contacting us:

• Name and email address (contact form / newsletter)
• Project information (description sent via WhatsApp or email)
• Anonymous browsing data via analytics (no personal identification)

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Data
paragraphs: We use your data exclusively to:

• Respond to your inquiries and quote requests
• Send service-related communications (with your consent)
• Improve our website and user experience

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: Where applicable under GDPR (EU/EEA visitors), we process your data on the following legal bases: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) for newsletter communications; our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) to respond to business inquiries; and contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b)) when we engage in a project.
For US residents, we comply with CAN-SPAM Act requirements for all commercial email communications.

sections.heading: 5. Email Communications & CAN-SPAM Compliance
paragraphs: If you subscribe to our newsletter or receive commercial emails from us, we comply with the CAN-SPAM Act:

• Every commercial email clearly identifies itself as an advertisement where required
• Our physical postal address is included in every commercial email: Rua Example, 123 — São José dos Campos, SP, Brazil 12220-000
• Every email includes a clear and conspicuous opt-out mechanism
• We honor opt-out requests within 10 business days
• We do not use deceptive subject lines or sender information
To unsubscribe from our mailing list at any time, click the 'Unsubscribe' link in any email we send or contact us at contato@forjadesistemas.com.br

sections.heading: 6. Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell or share your data with third parties, except for operational tools strictly necessary to provide our services (e.g., email delivery platform) under confidentiality agreements.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:

• Access, correct, or delete your data
• Withdraw consent at any time (without affecting processing already carried out)
• Data portability
• Object to processing based on legitimate interest
• Lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority (EU/EEA users: your national Data Protection Authority)
To exercise any of these rights, contact us: contato@forjadesistemas.com.br

sections.heading: 8. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only as long as necessary: contact and project data for up to 5 years for contractual and legal purposes; newsletter subscriptions until you unsubscribe; anonymous analytics data for up to 26 months.

sections.heading: 9. International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Our servers and service providers may be located outside your country, including in Brazil and the European Union. We ensure adequate protections are in place for any international transfer of personal data.

sections.heading: 10. Cookies
paragraphs: We use strictly necessary cookies for site functionality and, with your consent, anonymous analytics cookies. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy? Contact us: contato@forjadesistemas.com.br
